long_poll_request_secs.description: Telegram-side getUpdates long-poll wait in seconds

description.purpose: Bridges Telegram chats to the topology. Inbound chat messages emerge as one user-origin turn each; messages from the topology are written back to the chat.
description.use_when: Whenever a hive needs a Telegram surface. One proxy cell per bot token.
description.not_in_scope: Does not understand bot commands, does not keep chat history, does not transform messages beyond extracting text and identifiers.
description.emits_meaning: Two emission shapes, hence no required hop fields: (a) source emission — one user-origin turn per inbound Telegram message, hop carries chat_id/user_id/message_id/platform (promoted to context on edge 1); (b) inbound-error emission (missing_chat_id/missing_assistant_turn/send_failed/invalid_body) — empty messages[], hop carries error_code + msg_type 'proxy_inbound_error'. Declaring chat_id/platform as required breaks shape (b) against the substrate emits validation (run-1 finding, applied here pre-flight run-4).
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: the last assistant turn is sent to the chat. context.chat_id selects the target Telegram chat (promoted by the proxy's out-edge).
examples: Inbound Telegram 'Hi' -> emit body { messages: [{ origin: 'user', type: 'text', text: 'Hi' }] }, hop { platform: 'telegram', chat_id: 12345, user_id: 67890 }
